name: MMMU validation and test set
description: The dataset appears to consist of clinical cases and diagnostic questions related to various medical fields, including cardiology, radiology, neuropathology, ophthalmic pathology, electrocardiography, and pharmaceutical microbiology. It includes ground truth labels for each case, indicating the correct diagnosis or answer.
citeAs: Tsung-Yi Lin et al. Microsoft COCO: Common objects in context. In Computer Vision–ECCV 2014.

rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataCollection: The dataset results were derived from evaluations of various models, including Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs), based on their performance on specific tasks within the Humanities & Social Science and Tech & Engineering domains.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:annotatorDemographics: 50 university students from various disciplines, including co-authors.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for evaluating large multimodal models (LMMs) and stimulating the development of next-generation multimodal foundation models towards expert artificial general intelligence.
